subject: website
name: Kartikeya Sharma
summary: Kartikeya Sharma's research site, a Gatsby build whose bundles ship source maps with the sources. Most pages load only the site's own files and Google Fonts, but the projects page embeds a YouTube player as it opens, third-party code the visitor has not asked for. That is why it stays at Level 2 and not 3.
